notes.title: "Improved Mini Map & Enhanced Wrist Pad Experience"
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce a new update for our game that brings major improvements to the wrist pad mini-map and enhances the overall experience for players. The update includes:
[img]https://drive.google.com/file/d/1k6PjLvT4bAvsYIdH7zSkaajX9T6bPs33/view?usp=sharing[/img] 
Fixed wrist pad mini map: The mini-map has been updated to display the location of friends and enemies more accurately, allowing you to easily keep track of your teammates and opponents.

Display of friends and enemies: The minimap now displays the locations of both friends and enemies in real-time, giving you a better understanding of the battlefield.

Enhanced wrist pad experience: In addition to the updated minimap, we have also made several improvements to the wrist pad to make it easier to navigate and use during gameplay.

We hope these improvements will help enhance your overall gaming experience and make it easier to keep track of your friends and enemies in the heat of battle.

As always, please reach out to our support team if you have any questions or feedback regarding this update.

notes.title: "Reality End Update: Enhanced Cars, Improved Tanks, Optimized Minimap
notes.notes: "We're excited to announce the latest update for Reality End! With this update, we've made significant improvements to the cars, tanks, and minimap and added a brand new desert map. The cars now feature improved handling and smoother performance. The tanks have been re-balanced to provide a more immersive and challenging gameplay experience. The minimap has been optimized for better visibility and accuracy, helping you stay on track. The new desert map provides a stunning and challenging environment for you to explore and conquer. Download the update now and enjoy the improved Reality End experience!"

notes.title: Reality End New Version Free keys Giveaway
notes.notes:
It's been almost 3 months since Reality End last update.
The reason is that the game was built from the ground up. the old mouse and keyboard controller system have been removed, and the new game mechanics are ready. 
Currently, there are only 2 maps with 3 game modes. Another 2 maps are in development, with a new game mode for Defuse a bomb will be ready soon as well.
There is still a lot of planned content to available soon.
The game is now free! grab your key from the Discussion Forum.

Hope to see you on the battle ground!
